metadata.remarks:
Endpoint Threat Protection defines the capability for endpoints to defend themselves against active threats through runtime detection, prevention, and local containment. This pattern addresses malicious activity that evades preventive configuration controls and health baselines.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to endpoint threat detection and response. Controls are scoped to detection and local enforcement and exclude configuration management, posture evaluation, and centralized incident response.
